title: 2D Offset, Pass starts at Outside: many short ramped linear cuts and lifts instead of a continuous contour-parallel spiral

labels.name: P1

body:
## Report

The maintainer reported this bug in chat on 2026-11-23. Build: v0.26.0 `f729592f0` (the release branch `release/v0.26.0`).

His words: "When choosing "outside" on the page "Passes" the planner creates a path that is only "linear" with alot of uncessary lifts and transports.. instead of just do a circular motion from the outside into the mode. Not keeping the dool down, following the countour of the selection.. Instead it does a b unch of ramped cuts that would break the crap out of the cutter following the approach of the entry tab states and then offset cut following the selected contour.."

## Setup

- Operation: 2D Offset. Source: Selection. Tool: Ø8 end mill (EM-0800-4FL).
- Passes: Stepover 2.0 mm. Pass starts at: Outside. Stock to leave: 0.0 mm. Arc turns at corners: on. Arc radius = tool radius: on.
- Heights: Clearance = top of stock +10.0 mm. Top = top of stock. Bottom = selection bottom +1.5 mm. Stepdown 40.0 mm (one level).
- Status line: `3566 moves (7 plunge(s) @ 300, 1 level(s), 210 arc(s)), 0 warning(s)`. Turn blends: 169 of 1221 pass corners rounded, 457 of 1221 kept sharp.

## Seen

- The path from the stock edge toward the contour is many short linear segments.
- There are many lifts and transports between the segments.
- Many segments start with a ramped entry, as the Lead in / Lead out page sets.
- After these segments, the operation does the offset passes along the selected contour.

## Expected

- With "Outside", the tool enters one time outside the stock.
- It then stays down and cuts contour-parallel offset rings from the outside in toward the selected contour, with a stepover link from ring to ring.
- There are no lifts and no repeated ramped entries between the rings.

## Why P1

Repeated ramped entries into material and many short engagements can break the cutter. The posted program is wrong for the selected strategy.

## Notes

- PR #3577 merged on 2026-11-23 (`47aa341ff`). It changed the entry of a dead-end later Outside pass to a ramp along the pass. Check it first as a possible cause.
- PR #3620 merged on 2026-11-23. It changed the verifier slices. Check it as a second possible cause.
- This issue was found after the v0.26.0 cut line (2026-11-23T19:22Z). By the cut rules it is not on the cut list. The maintainer decides.
